title: Abstract, Presentation to the Scientific Counsel of GEPAN of Studies Undertaken During the First Semester of 1978: French Government UFO Study, June 1, 1978
doc_notes: This is an abstract of a French GEPAN report on UFO studies; it mentions the existence of humanoid encounter cases but does not provide specific details for them.

encounters.summary: GEPAN investigated 11 cases of high credibility and strangeness, two of which involved humanoid sightings.
encounters.quote: Two of the cases were humanoid sightings.
